nodes.title: aankde/tally sort: she types each row's total with stambh/tally's typed total (cell and pad, src/play/core/typedtotal.ts, one implementation for both families); 'Gino' waits for every total; solved only when the tally is right AND every total is the row's count, a wrong total is a miss; a run prints no row count while a try remains (a tick on a right row, the dashed box on a total that is not the row's), the counts and the survey's total show on the solved screen. The solver and both mal-rules type totals (tally-five: the strokes counted one by one, right; total-mismatch: her rows as they read). Reverse if: judges hold that the sort goal's skill is bundling only (then the run may read the rows again, and law 2 lists aankde/tally in KNOWN).
